Radio Technician
George Fisher Mine, Electrical
Mount Isa, Queensland, Australia
Ref. No. 105024

Mount Isa Mines are currently advertising for a Radio Technician vacancy that exists in the Electrical team.   This role is residentially based in Mount Isa, working a 7/7 day shift roster. We encourage suitably qualified and experienced local candidates to apply. For those candidates located outside of Mount Isa, relocation support is available for this position to enable you and your family to live and work in Mount Isa.

Mount Isa
For 100 years, Mount Isa has been a thriving city, acting as the hub for regional business, transport, services and government in North West Queensland. The city offers an array of leisure activities, from dining and cinema to outdoor adventures like fishing and camping. With Mount Isa Mines, you get the best of both worlds – a thriving career and a fulfilling lifestyle.

data.title: Production Manager
data.description:
The incumbent in this role is responsible for managing the delivery and execution of the Operational Plan for areas of responsibility, focusing on the areas of safety and production through selection, development and optimal utilisation of people and equipment; the daily, weekly and monthly monitoring of the relevant processes and delivery of targets; and the identification and management of risks.

Key Responsibilities
  • Participating in the formulation of the functional plan and engaging with Production Superintendents to ensure the proper execution of the plan and the monitoring the achievement of targets across areas of responsibility.
  • Providing input to ensure the capability and proper allocation, deployment, and optimisation of people and other resources.
  • Identification of hazards and risks in areas of responsibility and ensuring that proper controls are put in place to ensure the mitigation of these risks as well as the monitoring compliance to policies, regulations and standards.
  • Ensuring the understanding of processes by the teams in area of responsibility - ensuring the development of knowledge and sharing of best practice of these processes
  • Ensuring the creation of a culture and environment that is conducive for the delivery of targets.

data.title: Underground - Technical Advisor
data.description:
Kamoto Copper Company Société Anonyme, KCC SA in acronym, is a Congolese company operating in Kolwezi, capital of the province of Lualaba, in the Democratic Republic of Congo.

KCC SA exploits copper and cobalt ores on a large scale. It includes an underground mine, open-pit mines and integrated metallurgical facilities. The operation has one of the largest copper reserves in the world, with a current life of over 25 years.

As an industrial mining company, we provide safe workplaces and support the sustainable development of the local economy. We maintain a constructive and open dialogue with the communities that host us, as well as with the provincial and national government.
